description: This Java class 'OpenApiConfig' configures the OpenAPI documentation for the 'Ticket Data Metrics Service' application. It provides metadata such as title, version, description, contact info, license, server details, and API tags. The class is annotated with Spring's @Configuration and OpenAPI-specific annotations to define API metadata used for generating API documentation.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up OpenAPI metadata and tags for API documentation.
